overlap_period: Nov 2021 to Aug 2026 for matching; 2022 fire season for the other two checks
note: Checked on real NASA FIRMS detections where MODIS and VIIRS both flew.

metrics.label: MODIS detections also seen by VIIRS
metrics.detail: within 1 km and 60 minutes; 18.9 million MODIS detections over 1,693 days. VIIRS sees many small fires MODIS misses, so most VIIRS detections have no MODIS twin.

metrics.label: Fire energy agreement at map scale
metrics.detail: VIIRS fire energy predicting MODIS, summed per 2° square per day, on later days than the model was fitted on. Pixel by pixel it is only 0.07, so the map compares areas, never single pixels.

metrics.label: Finding the fire inside a MODIS pixel
metrics.detail: which 375 m cell VIIRS lights up, guessed from MODIS (0.5 = chance). Too weak to draw on the map yet.
